usedFor: Pivotal Tracker holds stories and Google Docs holds the log that “Add or Replace Text In Tab” writes.

bestTemplate.name: “New Story” in Pivotal Tracker, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new story is written into a doc tab, so product notes stay in one shared document.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can overwrite the tab, so pick add if you want a running log.
